title: I tried to make a first person FTL with a prehistoric setting. I'm not sure it worked?
author: jaqws
selftext: This game logic is mostly Claude's work after several hours of back and forth. How can I dial in the gameplay mechanics more? Link: [https://boompop.games/Embermarch/](https://boompop.games/Embermarch/)

comments.author: Ohgood9002
comments.body: Step 1. Use a game engine and avoid making a browser game

replies.author: jaqws
replies.body: Why? I personally play browser games all the time. Many steam games are just browser games in electron shells. What is your actual complaint?

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
why? Browser games are absolutely great and there are a lot of people in other countries who actually cannot afford to have machines that can run executable games even with the lowest graphics. iOS and Android games are their own thing, so browser games have a unique special place. 

why the hate?

replies.author: Ohgood9002
replies.body:
Learning how to utilize a game engine for game development is simply another tool/skill that is essentially a requirement to develop a full game. Don't sell yourself short by making sloppy browser games.

And if you do want to make broswer games, dont expect many players or any relevant feedback

replies.author: jaqws
replies.body: I know how to use Unity and Unreal engine. I made these with a specific type of user in mind who DOES like browser games. That's not you, and that's fine :)

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: I think OP explained that he was targeting browsed based players and to rebuttal your player feedback point, I think much like any other game or title, once he markets it or its seen by other visitors on gaming sites (like mine) they will be like "oh what's this new browser game" and try it out. How is the relevancy voided here? really not understanding your point. besides some sort of technical expertise snootiness . Let the man create

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: It's certainly different. I have the faintest clue what's going on. I should've done the tutorial. My only valid critique right now is the view is so obstructed by the cart. Can barely see what's what.
